Z-Anatomy 'Muscular system' collection (R2 muscle-v3-draco.glb) — the 62 connective-tissue sheets it carries alongside the muscle bellies (fascia, aponeurosis, retinaculum; e.g. Epicranial aponeurosis, Fascia lata, the thoracolumbar layers) are excluded by explicit object name, because they are not muscle and they sat at or above skin level. Tensor fasciae latae is kept (a muscle). 607 mesh nodes.

Z-Anatomy 'Visceral systems' collection (R2 visceral-v1-draco.glb) — the modelling meshes (118 surface objects: liver + its segments, gallbladder, stomach, pancreas, kidneys, urinary bladder, lung lobes, pleura, trachea, thyroid and parathyroid glands, salivary glands, tongue, palate, pharynx, pituitary and pineal glands, and that individual's male reproductive organs) PLUS curve-converted tubes that are equally real geometry: the segmental and lobar bronchi, the oesophagus, the jejunum, the bile duct, the pancreatic and accessory pancreatic ducts, the parotid and submandibular ducts, the ductus deferens, the ejaculatory ducts, the ureters and the urethra. Ten structures have their own rows (liver, stomach, pancreas, gallbladder, kidney, urinary bladder, trachea, thyroid gland, adrenal gland, lung) so those clicks open an entry; everything else in this layer still reports not-in-this-dataset.

Mesh node 'Pancreatic duct' confirmed present in the shipped viscera GLB (a converted curve tube). The source also names a separate 'Accessory pancreatic duct' mesh, which is left unmapped — and that is a deliberate choice, NOT a missing term. CORRECTED 2026-09-13: this note previously said no matching Uberon term was found, which the ontology contradicts. OLS4's curator note on UBERON:0007329 reads 'this class groups together accessory (dorsal) and main (ventral) pancreatic ducts', and that term's own description lists 'duct of pancreas', 'ductus pancreaticus' and 'pancreas duct' as synonyms. So the class does cover the accessory duct, and mapping both meshes to it would make one structure row stand for two separately named ducts that drain to different papillae; the accessory duct is therefore left unmapped and disclosed in the card instead. UBERON:0001064 remains the VENTRAL pancreatic duct on its own and was not used. Uberon id verified against OLS4 (label 'pancreatic duct', not obsolete).

sources.note: Z-Anatomy 'Cardiovascular system' collection (R2 cardiovascular-v1-draco.glb) — 676 surface nodes: heart chambers, valves, papillary muscles, pulmonary trunk, dural sinuses, plus 654 vessel tubes converted from beveled curves, i.e. the arterial and venous tree including distal limb coverage. Distinct from the HuBMAP blood-vasculature row, which is a different individual and trunk-only.

Z-Anatomy 'Nervous system & Sense organs' collection (R2 nervous-v1-draco.glb) — 580 surface nodes: brain surfaces, spinal cord parts, spinal dura, cranial and peripheral nerve tubes (247 converted from beveled curves). Honest gap: the eye's ciliary body has NO surface geometry in this source (its two curves are unbeveled and were dropped).

Mesh nodes 'Midbrain.l' and 'Midbrain.r' confirmed present in the shipped nervous-system GLB (R2 nervous-v1-draco.glb). This source carries the brain as its named parts, not as one whole-brain mesh. Uberon id verified against OLS4 (label 'midbrain', not obsolete).

Z-Anatomy 'Joints' collection (R2 joints-v1-draco.glb) — 409 surface nodes of periarticular structures only: joint capsules, ligaments, menisci, labra. Contains no bones (those are the skeleton row), so it reads as connective-tissue detail laid over the skeleton.

Z-Anatomy 'Lymphoid organs' collection (R2 lymphoid-v1-draco.glb) — 158 surface nodes: about 150 named lymph-node groups (cervical, axillary, inguinal, iliac, mesenteric, mediastinal, popliteal, etc.), palatine tonsils, thymus lobes and spleen. Lymphatic VESSELS are not part of this collection.
